'''Karen Fukuhara''' (born February 10, 1992) is an American actress. She is known for her roles as {{wp|Katana (DC Comics)|Tatsu Yamashiro}}/Katana in the 2016 superhero film ''{{wp|Suicide Squad (2016 film)|Suicide Squad}}'' and as Kimiko Miyashiro in the [[Prime Video]] original series ''{{wp|The Boys (TV series)|The Boys}}''. In the [[Pokémon]] franchise, she provided the English voice of [[Haru]] in the stop-motion [[animation|animated]] series [[Pokémon Concierge]].

==Biography==
Karen Fukuhara was born to Japanese parents in {{wp|Los Angeles}}, {{wp|California}}. Fukuhara's first language was Japanese, and she attended Japanese language school on Saturdays for 11 years. She has a younger brother. Fukuhara began practicing karate in middle school, and became a brown-striped belt before leaving for college.

Fukuhara attended {{wp|University of California, Los Angeles}}, while working as a reporter for a sports show on {{wp|NHK}} in {{wp|Japan}}. Fukuhara graduated from UCLA in 2014 with a Bachelor of Arts in Sociology and a minor in Theater.

Fukuhara has also participated in an a cappella group.<ref>[https://tvovermind.com/karen-fukuhara/]</ref>
